$comment: TK-2701 crude oil storage tank twin. Expected values in Maximo Monitor from the tank's design, calibration and inspection data; the device sends only what it measures.

identification.manufacturer: Field-erected welded steel tank (API 650) with external floating roof,
identification.model: Radar tank gauging with 2-in-1 independent high-high level (for example Emerson Rosemount 5900S)
identification.description: Crude oil storage tank in a terminal tank farm, external floating roof, 40 m x 18 m
identification.tank: Vertical cylindrical welded steel tank, flat bottom, API 650, external floating pontoon roof (API 650 Annex C)
identification.gauge: Radar automatic tank gauge on a still pipe, 2-in-1 housing: ATG + independent radar for the high-high alarm (for example Rosemount 5900S 2-in-1, instrument accuracy +/-0.5 mm)
identification.temperature: Multi-spot average temperature and water level sensor with a temperature transmitter (for example Rosemount 765 + 2240S)
identification.roof: Three non-contact roof position sensors at 120 degrees on the shell top, and a gas detector above the rim seal
identification.meters: Receipt and delivery line flow meters with flow computers (volumes at 15 degC)

geometry.source: Inside diameter and shell height: assumption: typical value, replace with your tank data sheet / strapping table / inspection report. The twin uses a constant cross-section in place of the strapping table (API MPMS Ch. 2.2A). Shell expansion coefficient of mild carbon steel 1.12e-5 per degC: assumption, typical value. CTSh uses the liquid temperature for the shell (simplification; API MPMS 12.1.1 also weighs in the ambient air for an uninsulated tank).

product.name: Crude oil
product.source: K0 = 613.9723, K1 = 0: generalised crude oils, API MPMS Ch. 11.1 (Table 54A). Nominal density at 15 degC and receipt temperature: assumption: typical value, replace with your tank data sheet / strapping table / inspection report

roof.source: Roof mass (deck, pontoons, legs, seals), rim space, pontoon rim height and operating leg height: assumption: typical value, replace with your tank data sheet / strapping table / inspection report (roof drawing and weight in the calibration report).

overfill.source: API 2350 levels of concern. CH (critical high): assumption: typical value, replace with your tank data sheet / strapping table / inspection report. HH and MW: placed one response time apart at the largest fill rate (2500 m3/h = 995 mm in 30 min); 30 min is API 2350's default minimum response time for a Category 2 tank.

shell.source: API 653 t_min = 2.6 (H - 1) D G / (S E), H = CH, S = min(0.80 Y, 0.429 T) for the bottom course, never below 0.1 in; external UT interval = min(RCA / 2N, 15 years). Plate grade (Y 38 ksi, T 70 ksi), joint efficiency 1.0, highest SG 0.90, nominal 19 mm: assumption: typical value, replace with your tank data sheet / strapping table / inspection report

bottom.source: API 653: minimum remaining bottom thickness at the next internal inspection 0.10 in (2.54 mm) for a bottom without means to detect and contain a leak. Nominal plate 8 mm and a planned 10-year internal inspection interval: assumption: typical value, replace with your tank data sheet / strapping table / inspection report

operation.source: Receipt by pipeline at 2000 m3/h up to MW, settling for 8 h, delivery at 1500 m3/h down to the low working level: assumption: typical value, replace with your tank data sheet / strapping table / inspection report

demo.note: Demo only: the plant clock runs 600 times faster (one real second = ten plant minutes), so one fill, settle, empty and settle cycle takes about three real minutes.

limits.source: Gauge disagreement 10 mm, tank-versus-meter 0.3 %, static loss 0.4 m3/h over at least 4 h, roof tilt 100 mm, roof draft 1.3 x expected, 300 mm above the landing height, 10 % LEL above the rim seal, bottom corrosion 0.2 mm/y: assumption: typical value, replace with your tank data sheet / strapping table / inspection report

failure_modes.$comment: Each failure mode: what degrades, how it shows, the rules that see it.

overfill.name: Receipt not stopped at the maximum working level
overfill.symptoms: level passes MW, time to HH shrinks, the independent high-high alarm trips the receipt

gauge_drift.name: Radar gauge drift or still-pipe deposit

bottom_leak.name: Bottom leak
bottom_leak.symptoms: net standard volume falls while the tank is quiet

meter_error.name: Flow meter over-reading
meter_error.symptoms: the tank level moves less than the meter says; quiet periods normal

roof_tilt.name: Floating roof tilt (pontoon leak, seal binding)
roof_tilt.symptoms: roof sensors disagree, mean draft normal

roof_drain_blocked.name: Roof drain blocked: water on the deck
roof_drain_blocked.symptoms: roof floats deeper than its weight explains

bottom_corrosion.name: Accelerated bottom corrosion
bottom_corrosion.symptoms: floor scan shows a high corrosion rate; minimum thickness at the next inspection below the API 653 limit
